unpolled_joined_deadline.before: A ready response wins over an expired timer and permits late extraction.
unpolled_joined_deadline.after: An explicit monotonic clock check refuses the shared bytes before extraction.

retained_invocations.result: Unqualified exact filter selected zero tests; not regression evidence.

measurement_limits: Local GET reduction is not a sustained TPS or latency result.
Read-owner/joined counters count admissions, including later failure or cancellation, not successful GETs or saved bytes.
Each member still independently hashes/decodes and physically replays; this experiment targets physical GET overlap only.
